import json, unreal
subsystem=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.LevelEditorSubsystem)
worlds=[]
for world in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.World):
    path=world.get_path_name()
    if 'UEDPIE_' in path or '/Temp/' in path:
        worlds.append(path)
print('V2_EDITOR_PLAY_STATE='+json.dumps({'inPIE':bool(subsystem.is_in_play_in_editor()),'playWorlds':worlds},sort_keys=True))
